feature: Thread usage meters on Pulse Next: plan usage ring and session cost in the web composer
owner: one Opus implementation owner, Fable integrates

port.rule: docs/operations/pulse-next-branches.md: port selected changes into a fresh branch from origin/develop; never merge the legacy branch wholesale.

reuse: ServerProvider.usageLimits (packages/contracts/src/providerUsageLimits.ts) is the plan usage source; no new server plumbing.
LimitWindows from apps/web/src/components/usage/UsageLimits.tsx renders the popover rows; no second window renderer.
@t3tools/shared/usageLimits helpers (remainingPercent, formatResetsIn) for headline selection and countdowns.
thread.token-usage.updated ingestion already stores the snapshot verbatim, so costUsd rides the existing context-window.updated activity.
upstreamEdits: packages/contracts/src/providerRuntime.ts: one optional field costUsd on ThreadTokenUsageSnapshot.
apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAdapter.ts: spread result.total_cost_usd as costUsd onto the emitted usage snapshot; never carry a stale cost forward.
apps/web/src/components/chat/ContextWindowMeter.tsx: optional costUsd prop rendering one row.
apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatComposer.tsx: render PlanUsageMeter beside ContextWindowMeter and pass costUsd (null when plan windows exist).
compatibility.mobile: No new native controls per pulse-next-migration.json clientCompatibility.releasedMobile. Mobile keeps the upstream /usage-limits card. Session cost is web and desktop only in this port.

supported: Web and desktop: ring beside the context window meter showing the most-used window of the selected instance's usageLimits; hidden when there are no windows or usageLimits.unavailable is set. Popover: plan windows via LimitWindows compact rows, checkedAt age. Red at or above 90 percent used.

Web and desktop: Session cost row in the context window popover from costUsd summed per handoff segment with monotone-run reconstruction; sub-cent shows <$0.01; hidden at 0 or when the selected instance reports plan windows.
Server: Claude adapter forwards total_cost_usd as costUsd on the token usage snapshot.
unsupported: Account credit balance: no provider exposes it.
Cost for Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode: no per-result cost reported.
Mobile native controls: policy keeps released mobile on upstream behavior; /usage-limits already covers plan windows there.
Mobile session cost: follows from the above.

acceptance.case: Ring absent until the selected instance has at least one usage window; absent when unavailable.reason is set.
acceptance.evidence: unit: selectComposerPlanUsage hides undefined limits, empty windows, unsupported and probeFailed

acceptance.case: Ring follows the composer's selected instance, including drafts before a thread exists.
acceptance.evidence: composerPlanUsage resolves providerStatuses by selectedInstanceId, which is defined before any thread exists

acceptance.case: Ring and popover update in place as account.rate-limits.updated events land; no remount, no timers.
acceptance.evidence: ring derives from the providerStatuses prop; the only clock is a useState re-anchored on popover open, no interval

acceptance.case: Window at or above 90 percent used renders destructive color.
acceptance.evidence: unit: isPlanUsageCritical false at 89, true at 90 and 100

acceptance.case: Popover rows use LimitWindows so they match the /usage-limits banner and Usage page.
acceptance.evidence: PlanUsageMeter renders LimitWindows compact; planUsagePercent derives from the shared remainingPercent helper

acceptance.case: Session cost sums across provider restarts (drop) and handoff segments; test [10 | handoff | 2 | 2 | 3] = 17 and [10, 2] = 12.
acceptance.evidence: unit: deriveThreadCostUsd, both cases assert exactly

acceptance.case: Cost hidden when selected instance has plan windows; shown for API-key Claude; <$0.01 below a cent; hidden at 0.
acceptance.evidence: unit: formatThreadCostUsd; inspection: costUsd prop is null whenever composerPlanUsage is set

acceptance.case: Claude adapter: result with total_cost_usd emits costUsd; result without it omits costUsd even when lastGoodUsage carried one.
acceptance.evidence: unit: 3 ClaudeAdapter tests (forwards, omits, does not re-emit stale)

acceptance.case: Older client decodes snapshot with costUsd; older server omitting it yields no cost row.
acceptance.evidence: unit: contracts decode of fractional costUsd, absent costUsd, and rejection of a negative value

acceptance.case: Compact web viewport keeps both rings and send on one row.
acceptance.evidence: needs a browser pass; no dev server or browser was run in this port

acceptance.case: Remote and relay: no new requests.
acceptance.evidence: no new RPC or fetch; plan usage reads the already-published ServerProvider.usageLimits and cost rides the existing context-window activity

acceptance.reason: Pulse Next policy: released mobile stays on upstream behavior.

evidence: typecheck clean (exit 0, zero errors): packages/contracts, packages/shared, packages/client-runtime, apps/server, apps/web
lint clean on every new file; ChatComposer and ChatView carry only pre-existing set-state-in-effect warnings
ingestion verified unchanged: buildContextWindowActivityPayload returns event.payload.usage verbatim, so costUsd rides through with no edit
blockers: Pulse Next emits no provider.handoff activity. deriveThreadCostUsd still segments on that kind so a future handoff port keeps money already spent; the segmentation is unit-tested but currently unreachable in this codebase.
Compact-viewport layout with both rings plus send on one row is unverified: this port ran no dev server or browser.
